verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships its own CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines, for building automated workflows on hosted or private runners, and can also connect to external CI such as Jenkins or Bamboo. It also documents triggering AI-powered automation tasks directly from the pipeline, so the core 'run in CI for automation' story is delivered. Missing for 10: any evidence of a headless CLI or REST API for driving Bitbucket non-interactively (only a Rovo terminal mention), in-depth Pipelines configuration docs beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
